intro.title: Emotion Temperature Choices
intro.sub: Which temperature metaphor fits these ten choices?
intro.desc: Choose one response for each everyday situation.
intro.boundary: This author-created activity is entertainment, not a psychological or health assessment.
intro.method: Each option shows 0–4 intensity points. Ten answers total 0–40; the published linear formula maps that total to −10–40°C and one of eight fixed ranges.

result.boundary: This temperature is a playful label for these answers. It does not measure emotion, personality, health, or behavior outside this activity.

share.text: Try this transparent ten-choice emotion-temperature activity.

q1.text: What if your close friend suddenly starts crying?
q1.o4: I feel awkward and don't know what to do 😶

q2.o2: A bit disappointed but quickly make new plans 😌
q2.o4: Feel hurt and my mood drops 😔

q5.o4: Don't want to do anything, just lie down 🛋️

q6.text: If someone leaves a hateful comment about you on social media?
q6.o2: Feel bad but forget by tomorrow 😤

q7.text: When talking about things you love?
q7.o1: Express with my whole body, super excited 🤩
q7.o2: Explain enthusiastically with a bright face 😃

q8.text: When you see a cute dog on the street?
q8.o2: Pet it with a big smile 😊

q9.text: How do you feel about being alone?
q9.o2: Sometimes needed but not for too long 🤷

q10.text: When someone says "I love you" to you?
